title: Cooper's Cottage
description:
Centrally-located in a quiet neighborhood, our place is great for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers! Cooper's Cottage is newly renovated and equipped with modern amenities: washer and dryer, covered parking, hair dryer, iron and ironing board, central heat and air, coffee maker and coffee, tea pot, pots pans and dishes. It is one block off a major Nashville artery, Nolensville Road, with lots of nearby restaurants and a 15-minute drive from the airport and downtown!

The space
1.3 miles from I-24 freeway. 1.7 miles to I-440. 1.5 miles to I-65. 4.4 miles to Nashville International Airport. 8 miles from Opryland Resort and Grand Ole Opry. 10 miles from Convention Center. 7 miles to the heart of downtown Nashville.

Other things to note
True House of Praise Church located next door. Sunday morning services start at 11am with rousing music.
